entries.13378ff4af10ad1c: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses, sunglasses, hearing aids and other products at wholesale to eyewear retailers and others nationwide. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥352 million (down 12.7% from the previous fiscal year), and the segment loss was ¥4 million (compared with a segment loss of ¥5 million in the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that the company is strengthening relationships with existing customers through new product launches and sales support, and is working to develop new customers.
entries.22c64a33c46bcfe2: The company combines technical skills in eyeglass processing, from vision measurement to processing and adjustment, with customer service that captures customers' requests and makes proposals. The securities report shows consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by product as follows: frames ¥5,070 million, lenses ¥6,056 million, hearing aids ¥1,975 million and other ¥2,180 million. The company also promotes acquisition of eyeglass qualifications (the national Eyeglass Craftsman certification) and certification as a hearing aid technician.

entries.5b2ecbe6b3c4316d: A reportable segment that emphasizes face-to-face sales service, opens stores in roadside locations, shopping centers, commercial buildings and similar places, and sells eyeglasses, sunglasses, hearing aids and other products to consumers in Japan. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥14,930 million (up 3.3% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥228 million (compared with a segment loss of ¥108 million in the previous fiscal year). The company operates "Megane no Aigan" stores, and its consolidated subsidiary Neoc Co., Ltd. (Abeno-ku, Osaka) also engages in eyeglass retailing, purchasing products from the company. The securities report says that eyeglasses, the main product, rose 3.3% from the previous fiscal year through higher prices for sales including lenses and proposal-based sales of lens options; hearing aids rose 7.0% through trial rentals and after-sales service; and sunglasses were flat year on year amid competition with other companies in the industry. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, there were 4 new store openings, 7 store closures and 10 store renovations. It also engages in online sales through its own EC site and Rakuten Ichiba.
